definition: [ מָסַר ] verb si vera lectio deliver up, offer (Late Hebrew מָסַר ; Aramaic deliver up, denounce, betray , מְסַר ; Hom ZMG xivi. 1892, 530 compare Sabean מסר take away ); — Qal Infinitive construct ׳ לִמְסָרמַֿ֫עַל בי Num 31:16 offer (commit) a trespass against ׳ י , but read לִמְעֹל , compare Thes Di (see Num 5:6 ; 2Chr 36:14 ). Niph`al Imperfect וַיִּמָּֽסְרוּ Num 31:5 delivered over to, assigned to (of warriors), read perhaps וַיִּסָּֽפְרוּ ( ᵐ5 . ἐξηρίθμησαν ) compare Thes . מֹסֵרוֺת , מָסֹ֫רֶת see אסר . [ מֹסָר ] see מוּסָר below יסר .

Niph`al Imperfect וַיִּמָּֽסְרוּ Num 31:5 delivered over to, assigned to (of warriors), read perhaps וַיִּסָּֽפְרוּ (ᵐ5. ἐξηρίθμησαν) compare Thes.
